bottleneck.description: Korean chemicals group; via OCI Company Ltd it makes solar- and semiconductor-grade polysilicon plus phosphoric acid and specialty gases. Non-China supply optionality but no concentrated, hard-to-substitute position.

dependency.key_customers: SK Hynix (semiconductor-grade phosphoric acid), CubicPV (polysilicon offtake), Nexeon (monosilane)

editorial.notes: Solar polysilicon is commoditised and roughly nine-tenths China-controlled, and OCI fell out of the global top ten producers in 2023; in semiconductor-grade polysilicon the leaders are Wacker, Hemlock and Tokuyama, with OCI a secondary source. Its one genuine lift is scarce non-China, forced-labour-clean supply plus qualified niches such as semiconductor-grade phosphoric acid to Korean memory makers, but that value is policy-contingent (US import and Section 232 measures) rather than a structural choke. Rated LOW: no concentrated position others cannot route around. It would rise to MEDIUM only if the non-China scarcity premium is weighted heavily.
